hints.text: Sort the items according to their price values in non-decreasing order.

hints.title: Running Maximum Beauty
hints.text: Precompute the maximum beauty achievable for each prefix of items.

hints.title: Price Threshold Lookup
hints.text: For each query value, find the last item with price at most the query using an ordered search.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import bisect

class Solution:
    def maximumBeauty(self, items: list[list[int]], queries: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        items.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
        prices = [item[0] for item in items]
        max_beauty = []
        cur_max = 0
        for item in items:
            cur_max = max(cur_max, item[1])
            max_beauty.append(cur_max)

        res = []
        for q in queries:
            idx = bisect.bisect_right(prices, q) - 1
            res.append(max_beauty[idx] if idx >= 0 else 0)
        return res
```

complexity.time: O((N + Q) log N) sorting items and binary searching queries
complexity.notes: Precomputing prefix maximum beauty allows O(log N) lookup per price query.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning all items for each query takes O(N * Q) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting and prefix max precomputations reduce queries to independent binary searches.
